name: WF-12: Google Drive Automated Knowledge Watcher & Ingester

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO knowledge_ingestion_log (
    document_title,
    source_type,
    total_chunks,
    total_characters,
    collection_name,
    ingestion_status,
    metadata
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.document_title }}',
    'google_drive',
    {{ $json.total_chunks }},
    {{ $json.total_characters }},
    'agrisensa_kb',
    'completed',
    '{{ JSON.stringify({ summary: $json.ai_summary, metrics: $json.extracted_metrics }) }}'::jsonb
) RETURNING id, created_at;

parameters.text:
=📚 *AGRISENSA KNOWLEDGE INGESTED*

File baru dari Google Drive berhasil dipelajari oleh AI:
📄 *Dokumen:* `{{ $('✂️ Semantic Chunker Node').item.json.document_title }}`
✂️ *Total Chunks:* `{{ $('✂️ Semantic Chunker Node').item.json.total_chunks }}`
📝 *Ringkasan:* {{ $('✂️ Semantic Chunker Node').item.json.ai_summary }}

_AI siap menjawab pertanyaan seputar SOP ini._
